Title: Preview: AKS support for FIPS compliant nodes

Body.Content:
The US government and National Institute of Standards (NIST) have established Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) that defines critical security parameters vendors must use to meet federal requirements.

AKS now supports FIPS compliant nodes so you can achieve FedRAMP compliance required for meeting the mandated data security and computing standards.

Learn more.
